profile.text: Shana Moleman, leader of Rim Billiton's 'Shana's Construction Crew.' Proficient in engineering techniques such as boring, tunneling, and laying concrete, she first came into contact with our Engineering Department during the renovation of a nomadic operation platform. Now, as a nonresident engineering consultant, she participates in relevant Rhodes Island missions under the codename 'Cement.'
